mainStory.purpose: Introduce HUANDENG as a working product: what it is, how a presenter uses it, and why its page-oriented, story-first model helps.
mainStory.audience: Researchers and builders who make scientific or product presentations with AI agents.
mainStory.takeaway: The audience should be able to explain the editor/project/plugin relationship, open a project, use Story and real assets, review a page-level change, reuse Main pages in a Presentation, deliver PDF/PPTX, and state the collaboration limits.

story.purpose: Explain the observations and design consequences behind HUANDENG: AI-looking decks, whole-deck copies, screenshot-only review, and the page-as-file model.
story.audience: Researchers and builders who make scientific or product presentations with AI agents.
story.takeaway: The problem is upstream of layout; the page is the unit of change and the unit of review.
